blocks.title: 使用前需要配置
blocks.content: 添加连接器时需要填写 Figma Personal Access Token；令牌只写入本机 MCP 配置。

blocks.title: Setup required
blocks.content: A Figma Personal Access Token is required when adding this connector. It is stored only in your local MCP configuration.
